summary: StudentRequirements is a user control for managing student compliance requirements. It supports listing, inserting, editing, and deleting student requirements through a user interface that utilizes multiple web controls, popups, and grid operations. The control interacts with data sources to retrieve and update information, with additional support for session management, validation, and asynchronous JavaScript updates.
purpose: To provide an interface for staff to view, create, update, and delete requirements associated with a student, ensuring compliance with organizational standards and tracking requirement statuses.

workflows.name: Manage Student Requirements
steps: Display list of student requirements in gridData.
Provide Add, Edit, and Delete buttons based on ScreenIsEditable.
Add new requirement: Show popup via btnShowPopup, insert using uxDetail.
Edit existing requirement: Show popup, change mode to Edit, pre-fill form fields.
Delete requirement: Confirm action, call DataLayer.StudentRequirements.Delete with StudentRequirementID and UserSession.SessionID, redirect.
View requirement details: Use modal and detail controls for selection.
Data binding and refresh after insert, update, or delete.
Hide add button and show 'no data found' message if screen is read-only.

business_rules: Actions (Add, Edit, Delete) are enabled only if ScreenIsEditable is true.
Grid disables edit fields if ScreenIsEditable is false.
Requirement codes that already exist for a student cannot be reselected in dropdown.
Session must be active for data source actions.
validations: Form input is validated (Page.IsValid check before insert/update).
Dropdowns for RequirementCode and ComplianceCode must be populated and have valid selections.
calculations: OtherCodeID is determined via Codes.CodeSearchID and injected into JavaScript variables.
Dropdowns dynamically filter values to prevent duplicate selection.
conditions: If UserSession is null, data source operations are cancelled.
If screen is read-only, add/edit/delete buttons are hidden/disabled.
system_behavior: Asynchronous or synchronous JavaScript registration based on ScriptMgr state.
Redirect after successful insert/update/delete to refresh state.
Controls auto-generate fields, moved to code-behind for customization.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for authentication and session management.
Grid control utilities for UI operations.
Dropdown and JavaScript utilities for dynamic form behavior.
exceptions: No session: Data operations are cancelled.
Duplicate code selection: Dropdown disables/filters values.
